label: The Greatest Luck
notes: Favorite item quest step: Go to the Maid Cafe

lines.text: *Jingle*

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Welcome ba... Hm?!

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Commander! Zwei!
Privaty?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Miss Privaty?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Why are you here...?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I heard the Maid Cafe was completely swamped, so I came by to help for a bit, and...

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Wait, that's not what matters right now!

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Is this it?
Privaty holds out a bookmark with a four-leaf clover.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Let me see...
Zwei stares at the bookmark, unblinking.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The shape, the four-leaf clover... It all matches.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: This is it! This is my bookmark!
We finally found it!

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Phew... Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It's yours? It's yours! It's really yours!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: See? Told you I was right.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: How did you...?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Rei and Ein came and told me what was going on,

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: about how you'd lost your bookmark yesterday.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You two were both still searching for it...?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Heheh!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Rei... Ein...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Phantom said that if it wasn't in the book, we should check all the places we went yesterday.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: She said she'd keep looking around the library.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Really...?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: As soon as I thought about where we went yesterday, I remembered we came to the Maid Cafe, so I reached out to Miss Privaty!
So that's why Privaty came.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Yeah. I contacted Poli and Miranda,

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: and they said you two had gone to meet Sugar in search of the bookmark.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: They also said they'd keep looking through the lost and found.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: We decided to look around the Outpost in all the places you went to yesterday...

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: And that's when we found your bookmark in the flowerbed near the Maid Cafe!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ugh! And here I was, searching every place we'd been to yesterday! I wasted so much time!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: If I'd only known, I would've searched the area in front of the cafe more carefully.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It was Miss Privaty, Naru 1, and me who saw it sitting there in the flowerbed!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Pretty awesome, right?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: B-but I told you that you didn't have to keep looking... Why did you...?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I mean, we all know how much that bookmark means to you.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: You carry it around with you every day.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yeah, you always keep it tucked in one of your books.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: It would've bugged me so bad if we gave up and never found it!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You both noticed...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Of course we noticed! We're besties, aren't we?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: As a third-year, I normally wouldn't say I'm besties with first- or second-years, but I'll make an exception for you.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Aren't you grateful?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... Why, yes.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thank you... so much.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Oh, and...!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: While we were searching, we bought this too!
Ein holds out a green string.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: A string?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I figured we could tie it to your bookmark once we found it, so that you wouldn't lose it again.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Also, take a look at this!
Ein holds up the end of the string.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: See the knot? Cute, right?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Wait, isn't that shaped like a... four-leaf clover?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That's right! I knew you'd notice right away.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Wow...
It's pretty.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Right? I figured you'd agree.
It goes really well with the bookmark, too.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Totally!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I picked the string!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ein tied the knot!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: And Miss Privaty paid for it!
Privaty did?!

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Wh-what...? Why are you looking at me like that, as if it's such a surprise?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I'm allowed to buy a string for my student, you know.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Miss Privaty...

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Here, take this too.
Privaty hands a hole punch to Zwei.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I figured it'd be easiest to punch a hole in the bookmark and thread the string through it.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: If you'd rather not put a hole in it, though, just let me know.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I can bring some glue instead.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: N-no, it's fine!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I don't mind punching a hole through it.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thank you so much, everyone.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thank you for searching with me, and for not giving up...

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: No need to thank us for just doing what was right.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Exactly. If I lost something I liked, you'd spend just as much time and effort looking for it.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What're you talking about? I'm not gonna help out next time.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'll just send Naru instead.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What?! Why?! That's so mean!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Anyway, Miss Privaty, I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Oh... I am too, actually.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Now that I'm feeling more relaxed, I'm suddenly starving.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: It's about that time of day. Should we go ahead and eat something?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What are our options?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Mind if I go check the kitchen?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Yeah, feel free. Ade already gave us permission to use whatever we need.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Then I'll come too!

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Sure. Come on and pick whatever you'd like.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I'll make anything you want to eat, and I mean anything!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: You're the best!
Ein, Rei, and Privaty head into the kitchen.
Zwei keeps staring at the bookmark and the string.
Why are you just staring at it?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: What?
The string. You have to thread it through.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh, right! Of course...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: First, make a hole...
Zwei takes the hole punch.
*Ka-chunk*
She punches a hole through a corner of the bookmark.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Then just thread the string through...
Zwei fumbles nervously.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Why won't it go in...?
Here, I'll do it.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Y-you want to do it...?
Yeah, hand it over.
I take the bookmark from Zwei.
Like this...
I carefully slide the green string through the punched hole.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Wow...! It went right through!
I tie it in a knot so it won't slip out...
This should do, right?
... then hand it back to Zwei.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That's great.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thank you, Teacher.
Zwei looks at the string now attached to the bookmark.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: With this, I really won't lose it anymore.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I bet I'll be able to find it quickly, even in a thick book.
Zwei looks at me as she holds the bookmark in both hands.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Teacher...
Yes?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: This feels so weird.
What does?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: When I first bought this bookmark,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I wasn't even sure I'd be alive for much longer.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I had this vague idea that I was going to die. I'd have an accident during an exam, or fail one, and... that would be it.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: But now...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'm in my second year here, and I'm still alive.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Not only that, but with Phantom, Poli, Miranda, and Miss Sugar...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I realized there are so many people who're willing to value what I value just because it's important to me.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I also realized that I have amazing friends and teachers,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: who keep going even when I'm ready to give up.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It's so weird and... incredible.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: It really does feel like this bookmark brought me good luck.
Good thing you got it back then, huh?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Yeah, I'm really glad I didn't lose it.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: But even if I had, I think I would've been able to find it again at some point,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: because I already have the greatest luck of my life—you, Teacher, and my friends.
I'm pretty sure I just received the best thanks someone could get.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hehe. Is that so?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Well, thank you again, Teacher.
Don't mention it.
*Grumble*

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... It looks like I'm pretty hungry, too.
I bet. You've been running around all day without eating anything.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Why hasn't anyone come back out?
Good question. Let's go check on them.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Teacher! Zwei!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Come to the kitchen! This place is seriously amazing!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Yeah! Hurry up, you two!
Want to go see what the fuss is about?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Sure.
Zwei rises from her seat.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Zwei! Hurry!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Come on, Zwei!
Zwei walks towards the greatest luck of her life...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Okay! I'm coming!
... with a great big smile on her face.
